ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (34) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Духовное начало» (dukhovnoe nachalo) is 'spiritual principle' and «благо» (blago) 'the good'; Strakhov's sentence on the difference between the two kinds of love is printed after his attribution, outside the quotation, and is translated where it stands.

Source observation: [32] The sentence «Разница между тою и другою любовью…» stands after the attribution «Федор Страхов.», outside the quotation; by its sense («первом случае» … and the following «Во втором же случае») it belongs inside Strakhov's passage, before [28]. Translated as printed.
Source observation: [30] «Вo втором» is printed with a Latin o in «Вo»; translated as «Во втором» ('In the second').
